desc: Barrett MRAD Deployment Kit: A Tactical Masterpiece Built for Precision and Power, Featuring A Bolt-Action Platform with Interchangeable .338 Lapua And 7.62x51 NATO Barrels, A Two-Port Muzzle Brake and OD Green Cerakote Finish. The Folding Adjustable Stock with Adjustable Cheek Rest, Magpul MOE Grip and Harris Bipod Deliver Combat-Ready Ergonomics While Five Magazines Per Caliber Keep You Loaded. Topped With a Leupold MK5 7–35 Scope and Backed by an MRAD Tool Kit, Spare Parts and Cleaning Kits, Two Multi-Cam Mag Pouches, VTAC Sling, Soft Shell Carrying Case and Rugged Pelican Hard Case — This Rig Is Ready to Deploy.
